library(ggcorrplot)

# Visualize correlation matrix as heat map
ggcorrplot(C[,ncol(C):1],
           legend.title = '',
           color = c('red4', 'white', 'skyblue3'),
           outline.color = 'white',
           lab = TRUE,
           lab_size = 3)

library(GGally)

# Pair plot of (a sample of) numerical variables
set.seed(1)
sample.idx <- sample(nrow(data), 10000)

ggpairs(data[sample.idx, numerical_cols],
        upper = list(continuous = 'points'),
        lower = list(continuous = 'cor'),
        progress = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = fare, y = trip_seconds)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +

  facet_wrap(vars(month), ncol=6)

ggplot(data, aes(x = fare, y = trip_seconds)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(vars(payment_type))

ggplot(data, aes(x = fare, y = trip_seconds)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(pickup_area), cols=vars(dropoff_area))

library(dplyr)

data %>%
  group_by(pickup_area, dropoff_area) %>%
  summarise(count = n(),
            across(c('trip_miles', 'trip_seconds', 'fare'), mean)) %>%
  mutate(mph = trip_miles / trip_seconds * 3600,
         cost_per_mile = fare / trip_miles) %>%
  print(width=Inf)

3 Simple Linear Regression

model <- lm(trip_seconds ~ fare, data = data)

summary(model)

Call:
lm(formula = trip_seconds ~ fare, data = data)

Residuals:
    Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
-7592.4  -208.0   -53.0   146.3  6345.5 

Coefficients:
            Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
(Intercept) 152.3703     2.7182   56.06   <2e-16 ***
fare         49.8534     0.1083  460.18   <2e-16 ***
---
Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

Residual standard error: 512.6 on 99998 degrees of freedom
Multiple R-squared:  0.6793,    Adjusted R-squared:  0.6792 
F-statistic: 2.118e+05 on 1 and 99998 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
coef(model) # See str(model)
(Intercept)        fare 
  152.37026    49.85337 
summary(model)$r.squared # See str(summary(model))
[1] 0.6792516
ggplot(data, aes(fare, trip_seconds)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm',
              formula = y ~ x,
              se = FALSE,
              color='orange') +
  ggtitle('Linear Regression')

# Compute mean squared error MSE
y <- data$trip_seconds
y.pred <- fitted(model) # Also fitted.values(model) and model$fitted.values

c(mean((y - y.pred) ** 2), mean(residuals(model) ** 2), mean(model$residuals ** 2))
[1] 262734 262734 262734
# Compute various sums of squares
ss.reg <- sum((y.pred - mean(y)) ** 2)
ss.error <- sum((y - y.pred) ** 2)
ss.total <- sum((y - mean(y)) ** 2) # SST = SSR + SSE
              
c(ss.reg, ss.error, ss.total)
[1] 55639398918 26273403944 81912802862
# Compute coefficient of determination R^2
c(cor(y, y.pred) ** 2,
  ss.reg / ss.total, # SSR / SST
  1 - ss.error / ss.total, # 1 - SSE / SST
  summary(model)$r.squared)
[1] 0.6792516 0.6792516 0.6792516 0.6792516

# Do F-test to combine categorical levels
large.model <- lm(trip_seconds ~ fare + factor(hour), data = data)

data.f <- data
hour_groups = list(c(4, 5), c(16, 17))
for (g in hour_groups) {
  label <- paste(g, collapse = '_')
  for (h in g) {
    data.f$hour[data.f$hour == h] <- label
  }
}

small.model <- lm(trip_seconds ~ fare + factor(hour), data = data.f)
summary(small.model)
